properties.name: security.jwt.secret
properties.description: Legacy JWT HMAC signing secret. Prefer security.jwt.secrets plus security.jwt.key-id for key rotation. No default is provided; applications must configure a strong secret with at least 32 bytes.

properties.name: security.jwt.key-id
properties.description: Active JWT signing key id written to the token kid header. The id must exist in security.jwt.secrets when multiple keys are configured.

properties.name: security.jwt.secrets
properties.description: JWT signing secrets keyed by key id. Keep old keys during rotation until previously issued tokens expire.

properties.name: security.jwt.refresh-expire-seconds
properties.description: Refresh token lifetime in seconds. Refresh tokens are type-bound and can be rotated or revoked through TokenRevocationStore.

properties.name: security.jwt.clock-skew-seconds
properties.description: Allowed clock skew in seconds when verifying JWT exp/nbf claims.
